payload.title: develop is red: the Cyclotron decision-flywheel git dependency breaks the python CI job and the wheel build, so Release cannot publish
payload.description: Papyrus PRs 167-170 merged 2026-10-09 17:09Z. PR 167 added a cyclotron extra in pyproject.toml with a git URL dependency on decision-flywheel. Since then the python CI job fails with ModuleNotFoundError decision_flywheel, and the smoke job fails because the wheel carries a direct git requirement. Release cannot publish; npm next stuck at 1.0.0-next.32. Fix: move the dependency to an optional Poetry group, skip Cyclotron scenarios when the module is missing.
